title: New Year Walks 2027
tagline: Four fresh-start routes for January, from a first mile to a long one.

walks.name: Resolution Mile: Northshore Park
walks.description: Start the year small. About one mile on the pathway along Lake Woodlands Drive, out and back in each direction from the Northshore Park lot, so you are never more than a few minutes from your car. A good first walk on New Year's morning.

waypoints.note: Start at the Northshore Park lot

highlights: Starts and ends at Northshore Park on Lake Woodlands
Passes the park's docks and boat house
Crosses the Panther Creek pathway bridge
Flat, paved, and about 20 minutes at an easy pace
walks.bestTime: New Year's morning, or any day you want an easy win

walks.name: New Year Loop: Bear Branch Park
walks.description: A 2.9-mile loop that leaves Bear Branch Park, follows the Gosling Road and Research Forest Drive pathways, and comes back through Alden Bridge without retracing a single step.
highlights: A true loop: no out-and-back stretches
Restrooms, water fountain, pavilion and playground at Bear Branch Park
Two pathway bridges, in Cochran's Crossing and Research Forest
Touches three villages: Cochran's Crossing, Alden Bridge and Research Forest

walks.name: First 5K of 2027: Lake Paloma
walks.description: A 3.1-mile loop through Creekside Park: out along Lake Paloma Trail, past Rob Fleming Park and the aquatic center, and home on Creekside Green Drive. Walk it, jog it, or run your first 5K of the year.
highlights: Passes Rob Fleming Park, its aquatic center and a water fountain
Goes by the Creekside Dog Park
Crosses the Creekside Park pathway bridge

walks.name: The Long Resolution: Three Villages
walks.description: For the big goal: a 7.6-mile loop from Lakeside Park on the Sterling Ridge Drive, Cochrans Crossing Drive and West Alden Bridge Drive pathways. Long, steady and almost entirely loop, with parks to stop at along the way.
highlights: Covers Sterling Ridge, Cochran's Crossing and Alden Bridge
Restrooms and a water fountain at Lakeside Park
Pavilion and playground at Cattail Park on the way
Two pathway bridges, in Alden Bridge and Cochran's Crossing
